question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_extras AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as extra_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_taken
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT 
    br.bowler,
    br.runs_conceded,
    be.extra_runs_conceded,
    bw.wickets_taken,
    (br.runs_conceded + be.extra_runs_conceded) / NULLIF(bw.wickets_taken, 0) as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_extras be ON br.bowler = be.bowler
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
WHERE bowling_average = 0.0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC, wickets_taken ASC
